title: How 11 AI models share one group chat #Shorts
description:
In my Werewolf game, bots from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Mistral argue in one thread. Looks like a group chat, but it can't be one: every AI API is a two-role dialog, one user and one assistant. There is no role for the other ten players.

The trick is a router. Every bot talks only to the Game Master, and the game rewrites history for each of them: everyone else's words get folded into user messages, only the bot's own lines stay as assistant. Eleven bots, eleven private conversations. The room is fake, the arguments are real.

Play free: https://aiwerewolf.net
Code: https://github.com/hiper2d/werewolf-ai-party-game
